Command-line program for syncing files with dozens of cloud and network storage providers. DFTB runs it to upload, download and verify backups on remote destinations.
Single executable providing hundreds of Unix utilities. DFTB uses it for a consistent shell toolset when running in root mode, independent of the device vendor\'s binaries.
Fast lossless compression algorithm and tool by Meta. DFTB\'s default archive format (.tar.zst) and compressed partition images use it.
LZMA2-based compression utilities and the liblzma library. DFTB uses the xz tool for high-ratio .tar.xz archives and .xz image compression.
Parallel implementation of gzip that uses every CPU core. DFTB uses it to produce standard .gz output quickly on multi-core devices.
Cryptography and TLS toolkit. DFTB invokes the openssl tool for streaming AES encryption of archives and for checksum generation in root mode.
The GNU archiving utility. DFTB uses it to create and extract tar archives that preserve ownership, permissions, SELinux contexts and extended attributes.
Fast incremental file transfer tool. DFTB uses it for 1:1 mirror backups and for delta synchronisation to local and SSH destinations.
Android library by topjohnwu for running commands in a root shell and accessing files as root. DFTB\'s root and module tiers are built on it.
Client library for the Shizuku service. DFTB uses it to run privileged file operations with ADB-level permissions when the user has enabled Shizuku.
Android\'s declarative UI toolkit. Every screen in DFTB is built with Compose and Material 3.
Persistence library over SQLite. DFTB stores backup profiles, job history and destination settings in a Room database.
Deferrable background work scheduler. DFTB uses it to run scheduled and constraint-aware backups.
Typed, asynchronous key-value storage. DFTB keeps app preferences such as language, theme and operating mode in DataStore.
Navigation framework for Compose. DFTB uses its type-safe routes to move between screens.
Dependency injection framework for Android built on Dagger. DFTB uses it to wire repositories, engines and view models.
Google\'s Material Design component library and theming system. DFTB\'s visual design, colours and dynamic theming follow Material 3.
Google\'s open-source icon set. All icons in DFTB are Material Symbols and Material Icons.
Programming language and standard library by JetBrains. DFTB is written entirely in Kotlin.
Library for asynchronous programming with Kotlin coroutines. DFTB uses it for all background and streaming work.
Multiplatform serialization library. DFTB uses it for backup manifests, exported settings and type-safe navigation routes.
Java library for tar, zip, 7z, gzip, bzip2, xz and zstd archives. DFTB uses it for the pure-Kotlin archive engine on devices without root.
Utility library for streams and file operations. DFTB uses it for robust copying, hashing and temporary file handling.
Client implementations of network protocols. DFTB uses it for FTP and FTPS destinations.
Pure Java implementation of XZ and LZMA compression. DFTB uses it to read and write .xz archives without native tools.
SSHv2 library for Java. DFTB uses it for SFTP destinations and for streaming backups over SSH.
SMB2 and SMB3 client library. DFTB uses it to back up to Windows shares and NAS devices.
HTTP client for the JVM and Android. DFTB uses it for WebDAV, S3 and other HTTP-based destinations.
Efficient I/O library that underpins OkHttp. DFTB uses its buffered sources and sinks for streaming pipelines.
Cryptography provider for Java. DFTB uses it for OpenPGP encryption and for algorithms not available in the Android platform.
File archiver with the 7z format, with p7zip as its POSIX port. DFTB reads and writes .7z archives compatible with 7-Zip; the tool itself is not bundled.
App by RikkaApps that exposes system APIs with ADB or root privileges to other apps the user authorizes. DFTB\'s Shizuku tier connects to it when installed.
Systemless root solution for Android. DFTB\'s companion module uses the Magisk module format and can back up and restore installed modules.
Kernel-based root solution for Android. DFTB\'s companion module is compatible with KernelSU\'s module format.
Kernel-patching root solution for Android. DFTB\'s companion module is compatible with APatch\'s module format.
Team Win Recovery Project, a custom recovery for Android. DFTB can write partition backups in a nandroid-style layout that TWRP can restore.
Custom recovery based on TWRP. DFTB\'s partition backups follow a layout compatible with OrangeFox restores.
Fast cryptographic hash function. DFTB ships its own implementation of the BLAKE3 specification for checksum files and verification.
Kotlin Symbol Processing API by Google. Used at build time to generate Room and Hilt code; nothing from it ships in the app.
Build automation tool and the Android Gradle Plugin. Used to compile and package DFTB; nothing from them ships in the app.
